record.paper_title: Billiard Dynamics: A Survey with the Emphasis on Open Problems
record.original_question: For a rational polygon P, does the limit lim_{ℓ→∞} f_P(ℓ)/ℓ^2 exist, where f_P(ℓ) counts periodic bands of length at most ℓ? Equivalently, does every rational polygon have quadratic asymptotics?

evidence.quote: In all examples computed so far fP(ℓ)/ℓ2 has a limit, i. e., c∗(P) = c∗(P) = c(P). In this case, we say that the polygon has quadratic asymptotics.
Problem 13. Does every rational polygon have quadratic asymptotics?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a rational polygon, that is, a simply connected planar polygon all of whose interior angles are rational multiples of $\pi$. Consider the billiard flow on $P$: a point particle moves in straight lines inside $P$ and reflects elastically (angle of incidence equals angle of reflection) upon hitting the boundary, with corners excluded.

A periodic billiard trajectory in $P$ always belongs to a maximal parallel family ("band" or "strip") of periodic trajectories of the same length and direction. For $\ell > 0$, let
$$f_P(\ell) = \#\{\text{periodic bands in } P \text{ of length at most } \ell\}.$$
Define
$$c_*(P) = \liminf_{\ell \to \infty} \frac{f_P(\ell)}{\ell^2}, \qquad c^*(P) = \limsup_{\ell \to \infty} \frac{f_P(\ell)}{\ell^2}.$$

Say that $P$ has quadratic asymptotics if $c_*(P) = c^*(P)$, i.e. if the limit
$$c(P) = \lim_{\ell \to \infty} \frac{f_P(\ell)}{\ell^2}$$
exists and is finite.

Question: Does every rational polygon $P$ have quadratic asymptotics?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of quadratic asymptotics for periodic band counts in general rational polygons is known to be open. It has been resolved (with explicit constants, via the work of Veech, Eskin–Masur, Eskin–Mirzakhani–Mohammadi, etc.) for special cases such as Veech surfaces and generic translation surfaces in any GL(2,R)-orbit closure, but the general rational-polygon case remains unresolved in the surveys on billiard dynamics.

status_evidence.title: Rational billiards and flat structures — Masur, Tabachnikov
status_evidence.snippet: Quadratic upper and lower bounds c_*(P) and c^*(P) on the number of periodic families are discussed; equality (existence of the limit) is established only in special (e.g. Veech) cases.
status_evidence.claim: The existence of the limit f_P(ℓ)/ℓ^2 for general rational polygons is not established and is posed as a problem.

status_evidence.title: Survey Lecture on Billiards — R. E. Schwartz
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys current state of periodic orbit counting in rational polygonal billiards; quadratic asymptotics known only in special cases.
status_evidence.claim: The general question of quadratic asymptotics for rational polygons remains open.
